items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: Back in 1989 there was a publication called Urban Profile that was started by Keith Clinkscales and Leonard Burnett

ctx.x: But you found a way to work in jazz as a writer and a producer. How did that sort of evolve?

Well let’s see. Well the writer is first. Back in 1989 there was a publication called Urban Profile that was started by Keith Clinkscales and Leonard Burnett — their first magazine. They later went on to jointly put out five magazines, Savoy Magazine, they both have very successful careers. Len Burnett is now I think the chief revenue officer — they create these titles — for Uptown Magazine, which is based in Harlem but that covers goings on for I’d say the upper middle class black society, the black community in…
at a really well-healed publication, it’s really hard to make a living at free-lance writing. So I’ve always had to supplement, you know, teaching and doing other things.
